title: 59--NEW REQUIREMENT WHS RESISTOR CAPACITOR
agency_path: INTERIOR, DEPARTMENT OF THE.BUREAU OF RECLAMATION.GRAND COULEE POWER OFFICE
detail_text: WHS Resistor Capacitors, Grand Coulee Power Office, Grand Coulee, WA The Bureau of Reclamation (BOR) Reclamation has a need for Resistor Capacitor Assemblies Maximum Voltage 242 KV, Short Circuit Current 54KA, Impulse with Stand 900KV, Continuous Current 2500 AMPS, Voltage Range Factor K 1.10, Interrupting Time 3 Cycles, Operating Mechanism Type P45A, Typical For A Type 230KM 25,000-25 Oil Circuit Breaker, S/N 41-30058-9011, Reference ITE Manual 051-L020-06 Issue B ITE Part Number: 767D029-01 or Equal This acquisition is 100% SET-ASIDE FOR WOMEN OWNED SMALL BUSINESSES. Reclamation intends to award one firm fixed-price contract. The anticipated award date is the third week of May. Prospective vendors must be registered in the System for Award Management (SAM) at the time the quote is submitted. This supply will be purchased in accordance with FAR Part 12.
